title: Has good sides and a bad side
text: Has good sides and a bad side. Ok, I must admit, I have been using Swiffer jet mops for years now almost exclusively. Due to the cost and the pain in changing disposable refills often, I have been looking for an alternative. This mop is a nice one, easy to set up and to use. Negative for me is the refillable cleaning liquid container which hardly holds enough for me to finish up my large family room and kitchen (tile). I found myself refilling more than I would have liked. It did do a good job, however, and the pads were easy to put on and off. I will continue to use until I find something I like better.Had
